items.body: The new boolean-only summaries lose scalar length identities. A previously admitted handler containing `let n = self.values.len(); if n < 2 { self.values.push_back(7); }` now refuses with “requires an authored bounded length guard.” The initializer becomes `Local`, but comparison recognition still requires a literal `Length(Var(field))` operand. Before this change, local substitution preserved that shape. This contradicts the task’s representation-only compatibility contract, and the new boolean-sharing test misses it.
items.suggestion: Preserve memoized length identities when resolving comparison operands, without expanding definition trees. Add a regression covering the cached-length handler and an equivalent unbounded negative control.
